- Notes: Title: NULL rwlock dereference in CRYPTO_secure_used when secure heap is not initialized. Component: CRYPTO/MEM_SEC. Trigger behavior: NULL_DEREFERENCE_CRASH. gdb shows pthread_rwlock_rdlock(rwlock=0x0) via CRYPTO_THREAD_read_lock(lock=0x0) inside CRYPTO_secure_used(). Version provenance confirms current OpenSSL 3.5.5 static libcrypto.a linkage, while historical affected/fixed versions remain unknown locally. secure_heap_state_lifecycle_v1 is D_then_B seed validation / oracle calibration, not full cross-library migration. Next stage must run same-family, cross-version, or analogous lifecycle pattern expansion. No confirmed vulnerability or CVE claim.
